title: Autonomous Shell Execution
description: Run shell commands directly from prompts. The agent handles bash, PowerShell, and cmd - with built-in timeout and safety controls.

title: Surgical File Editing
description: Read, write, and perform precise find-and-replace edits across your codebase with exact string matching - no accidental overwrites.

title: Context-Aware Reasoning
description: Automatic context compaction and loop detection keep the agent focused, preventing repetitive actions and token waste.

title: Configurable Safety Policies
description: Choose from suggest, auto-edit, or full-auto approval modes. Command-level allow/deny lists keep destructive operations in check.

title: MCP Tool Integration
description: Connect external tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Add custom capabilities through stdio or SSE-based servers.

title: Session Persistence & Undo
description: Save, resume, and checkpoint sessions. Every file change is tracked with automatic undo support - roll back any edit instantly.

title: Glob & Grep Search
description: Find files by pattern and search contents with regex. Navigate massive codebases with precision using built-in glob and grep tools.

title: Sub-Agent Architecture
description: Delegate complex subtasks to specialized sub-agents. Each runs in its own context for parallel, focused problem-solving.
